item.name: Top Potions List Island Chest
item.landmark: Top Potions List, Lombart NPC, and Lemin NPC
item.locationHint: On the sandy island or drop-off beside the spawn leaderboard platform.
item.howToReach: From spawn, move to the platform between Lombart and Lemin where the leaderboards sit, turn right, and hop down to the sand.
item.rewardNotes: Shared chest rewards. Exact chest-specific reward pools are not clearly listed.
item.travelTip: Grab this before leaving the spawn shoreline for the river path.

item.name: Spawn River Rocks Chest
item.landmark: River, rocks, tree, and first farming area
item.locationHint: Between rocks near the early river route and first enemy farming area.
item.howToReach: Run straight from spawn along the river path, avoid the Pickaxe Dwarfs if needed, then check the rock gap near the tree.
item.rewardNotes: Shared chest rewards. Exact chest-specific reward pools are not clearly listed.
item.travelTip: Stay moving if you only want the chest, since early dwarfs can slow the route down.

item.name: Traveler's Tent Chest
item.landmark: Traveler NPC, Cauldron, tent, and bridge
item.locationHint: Behind the tent beside the Traveler NPC and Cauldron.
item.howToReach: Head through the Knife Goblin and Warhammer Dwarf route, turn left, cross the bridge, and check behind the Traveler's tent.
item.rewardNotes: Shared chest rewards. Exact chest-specific reward pools are not clearly listed.
item.travelTip: Use the tent as the landmark instead of fighting the nearby enemies.

item.name: Miner Cave Chest
item.landmark: Optimistic Miner NPC and boarded mine entrance
item.locationHint: Inside the mine near the Optimistic Miner route.
item.howToReach: Climb the platform past the first Pickaxe Dwarfs, turn left toward the plant-covered boards, enter the mine, and collect the chest inside.
item.rewardNotes: Shared chest rewards. Exact chest-specific reward pools are not clearly listed.
item.travelTip: Enter from the main boarded entrance instead of trying to force the thorny top path.

item.name: Secret Mine Cave Chest
item.locationHint: Past the right side of the back wall inside the mine.
item.howToReach: After opening the miner cave chest, stay inside the mine and walk through the right side of the back wall to reach the hidden cave.
item.rewardNotes: Shared chest rewards. Exact chest-specific reward pools are not clearly listed.
item.travelTip: Do this immediately after the miner cave chest so you do not backtrack into the mine later.

item.name: Mine Mountain Top Chest
item.landmark: Mine mountain, rocks, and thorny vines
item.locationHint: On the upper platform above the mine.
item.howToReach: Exit the mine, climb from the rocks on the left side of the entrance, follow the thorny vines toward the upper platform, and check the top.
item.rewardNotes: Shared chest rewards. Exact chest-specific reward pools are not clearly listed.
item.travelTip: Movement speed or better jump height helps here, but the climb is reachable without a special item.

item.name: Lighthouse Island Chest
item.landmark: Lighthouse, sea, and small island mountain
item.locationHint: Behind the mountain on the small island next to the lighthouse.
item.howToReach: From the Traveler and Cauldron side, run left past Archer Goblins and Warhammer Dwarfs until you reach the sea, then hop to the small island near the lighthouse and check behind the mountain.
item.rewardNotes: Shared chest rewards. Exact chest-specific reward pools are not clearly listed.
item.travelTip: Group this with the Dwarf King and treehouse checks so the beach route is only done once.

item.name: Dwarf King Throne Chest
item.landmark: Dwarf King spawn, hammer wall, chains, and rock
item.locationHint: Behind the rock near the chained stone at the Dwarf King throne area.
item.howToReach: Use the lighthouse route, turn toward the mountain where Dwarf King spawns, walk to the hammer wall, then look far right behind the chained stone.
item.rewardNotes: Shared chest rewards. Exact chest-specific reward pools are not clearly listed.
item.travelTip: Check the chest without starting a long boss fight if your goal is only a material run.

item.name: Treehouse Platform Chest
item.landmark: Large tree, rope, railing, and treehouse door
item.locationHint: On the right side of the treehouse railing near the door.
item.howToReach: From the lighthouse side, look up for the huge tree, reach the rope, climb to the treehouse platform, and check the right side of the railing.
item.rewardNotes: Shared chest rewards. Exact chest-specific reward pools are not clearly listed.
item.travelTip: Tilt the camera upward near the lighthouse route to spot the tree faster.

item.name: Goblin Camp Hidden Platform Chest
item.landmark: Bridge, Knife Goblins, campfire, brown pine trees, and mountain platform
item.locationHint: On a hidden platform behind the goblin campfire route near the bridge path.
item.howToReach: Before crossing the bridge toward the Traveler camp, climb the rocks on the right, follow the brown pine trees, find the Knife Goblins and small campfire, then jump to the platform behind them.
item.rewardNotes: Shared chest rewards. Exact chest-specific reward pools are not clearly listed.
item.travelTip: This is easy to miss if you only follow the bridge, so check the rocks beside the bridge before leaving the starter side.
